mapper.select: SELECT s.schedule_id AS scheduleId, s.medication_id AS medicationId, NVL(m.item_name, '복약') AS name, CASE WHEN m.item_name LIKE '%비타%' OR m.item_name LIKE '%유산균%' OR m.item_name LIKE '%오메가%' THEN 'supplement' WHEN s.cabinet_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'supplement' ELSE 'regular' END AS type, TO_CHAR(s.scheduled_at, 'HH24:MI') AS time, TO_CHAR(s.taken_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS takenAt, 1 AS alarmEnabled FROM schedules s LEFT JOIN medications m ON s.medication_id = m.medication_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND TRUNC(s.scheduled_at) = TO_DATE(#{date}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY CASE WHEN s.taken_at IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, s.scheduled_at ASC

SELECT TO_CHAR(s.scheduled_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "scheduleDate", 0 AS "hasPrescription", 1 AS "hasRegular", MAX(CASE WHEN m.item_name LIKE '%비타%' OR m.item_name LIKE '%유산균%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "hasSupplement" FROM schedules s LEFT JOIN medications m ON s.medication_id = m.medication_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND TO_CHAR(s.scheduled_at, 'YYYY-MM') = #{yearMonth} GROUP BY TO_CHAR(s.scheduled_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
